assets.role: Three attached shop/home frontages, complete return and continuous roof; whole group.

Complete rear store/loading range; roof and ground-level faces coordinated.

Compartmented metal type, stone composing surface and paper as one workstation.
Original generic serving counter/tray with weather cover; not a Dibbler character asset.
Coordinated wall dressing: noticeboard, CLOSED shutter, repairs, scratch marks and damp base; not a door.
